objective: Wire `grove init --as mcp-llm` to shell out to `grove-explore config`, falling back to a graceful PATH-absent degrade that still registers both servers and exits 0.
key_changes: Replace the sibling-directory lookup in `cli/src/init.rs` with a PATH probe via `which::which("grove-explore")`.
Introduce a command-value fallback that writes the bare string `grove-explore` into MCP registrations when the sibling is absent.
Restructure the first-run TUI block so the non-TTY fast-fail is conditional on the sibling being on PATH.
When `grove-explore` is absent from PATH, degrade: complete harness reconciliation, print setup message, exit 0.
Update `write_json_mcp_explore_server` and `write_toml_mcp_explore_server` to use the fallback command value.
Add PATH-controlled integration tests for the degrade path and the non-TTY fail-fast path in `cli/tests/cli.rs`.
Leave `--dry-run`, non-mcp-llm targets, and the existing transition-matrix semantics unchanged.
Workspace green: `cargo test --release --locked` and clippy with warnings-as-errors.
